ja:

THE STOCK MARKET. TO MAKE
MONEY YOU MUST BUY STOCKS
WHILE THEY ARE SELLING LOW

ARE SELLING HIGH.<WAIT>

ON SUPPLY AND DEMAND. THE
MORE BUYERS, THE HIGHER THE
PRICES. THE MORE SELLERS,
THE LOWER THE PRICES.
<WAIT>
SEVERAL THINGS CAN AFFECT
STOCK PRICES: COMPANY SALES,COMPANY PLANS AND INTEREST
RATE FLUCTUATIONS.
<WAIT>
THE MORE SENSITIVE A COMPANYIS TO CHANGES IN INTEREST
RATES, THE MORE RISKY THE
INVESTMENT.
<WAIT>
INTEREST RATE CHANGES AFFECTHOW MUCH YOU SPEND AND BUY.
WHEN INTEREST RATES
INCREASE, YOU WILL TEND TO
SAVE MORE AND SPEND LESS.
<WAIT>
DURING A RECESSION, PRICES
ARE HIGH, THEREFORE YOU WILLTEND TO SPEND LESS.
<WAIT>
THE MORE DEBT A COMPANY HAS,THAT IS THE MORE MONEY THEY
OWE, THE MORE SENSITIVE THEYARE TO INTEREST RATES.
<WAIT>
THE HIGHER THE ASSET BASE,
THAT IS ALL PROPERTY AND
GOODS THAT HAVE HIGH VALUE,
THE LESS SENSITIVE THE
COMPANY IS TO INTEREST
RATES.<WAIT><END>
